biography:
I am a results-oriented Senior Sales Executive and Sales Director with a wealth of experience spanning more than 15 years. My career has been defined by leading high-performing sales teams to consistently achieve and surpass revenue targets. Proficient in formulating and executing strategic sales plans, I have a track record of driving market penetration, revenue growth, and profitability. My strengths lie in nurturing crucial client relationships and adeptly navigating complex negotiations which has led to a consistent track record of delivering exceptional sales performance. I'm proud to be recognised for my outstanding leadership qualities and I excel in mentoring and motivating senior sales teams to exceed expectations, all while maintaining an unwavering focus on organisational objectives. 

Throughout my career I have;

 - Led large global sales and commercial teams in the technology sector for more than 15 years, consistently achieving exceptional results through meticulous strategic planning and execution.

 - Successfully delivered year-on-year revenue and EBITDA growth across various organisations, even during periods of significant change. Notably, I have closed substantial deals valued at £50M and beyond, showcasing my ability to transform performance while meeting financial targets.

 - Built, developed, and led high-performing sales, business management, and commercial teams. These
teams, often comprising 70 to 80 professionals across multiple management layers, have been instrumental
in fostering a culture of excellence and consistently delivering outstanding results.

 - Gained a reputation for being a customer-focused negotiator and operator, always delivering value and forging robust customer relationships across Hyperscalers, System Integrators, SaaS and Professional  Services Organisations.

 - Managed large global sales teams and sizeable P&L's, demonstrating my capability to drive business
development, handle intricate negotiations, and consistently deliver exceptional results

 - Successfully led and managed various high-impact projects, including initiatives related to workplace
transformation and employee engagement, underlining my dedication to organisational improvement.
